scope: Only forty fixed horizontal dash cases; native/frame/primary and both white PDF routes, with native-page ink coverage, are required.

primary.scope: Forty fixed horizontal dash lines; original-SVG primary trial only; independent PDF/interaction admission pending.
primary.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9 channel units; every other limit is the independent observation in that exact region/view/background.

original.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
original.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.
original.inkCoverageRule: Exact integer per-channel sums of 255 minus each opaque white-backed sample, on fixed native page crops; actual ranges come only from independent SVGs, with no margin.

native.scope: Only forty fixed horizontal lines against their qualified unchanged ordinary PDF/Cairo.
native.rounding: Per-view/per-region maxima of exactly eight oracle-only native representations; foreground means rounded upward to 1e-9. No extra margin.
native.inkCoverageRule: Exact integer per-channel sums of 255 minus each opaque white-backed sample, on fixed native page crops; actual ranges come only from independent SVGs, with no margin.

instructions.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
instructions.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.
instructions.inkCoverageRule: Exact integer per-channel sums of 255 minus each opaque white-backed sample, on fixed native page crops; actual ranges come only from independent SVGs, with no margin.
